content: अपेहि (<ab>Imper.</ab> 2nd <ab>sing.</ab>) Used as the first member of some compounds (belonging to the class मयूरव्यंसकादि <ls>P. II. 1. 72</ls>); ˚करा, ˚द्वितीया, ˚प्रघसा, ˚वाणिजा, ˚स्वागता where it has the sense of ‘excluding’, ‘expelling’, ‘refusing admission to’; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} ˚वाणिजा a ceremony where merchants are excluded; so ˚द्वितीया <ab>&c.</ab>
